dfz7nkcpg48xfINSERT INTO GLBTRNVALIDRES(ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, MSGCD, MSGDESCR, WARNINGMSG) SELECT :"SYS_B_00", :"SYS_B_01", :"SYS_B_02", :"SYS_B_03"||NAME||:"SYS_B_04"||ACCNT||:"SYS_B_05"||TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_06" FROM ( SELECT A.ACCNT, A.TOTODAMT, A.GMST_CODE, B.NAME FROM ( SELECT :"SYS_B_07", :"SYS_B_08", COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_09"+B.AC_NO) AS ACCNT, SUM(DECODE(NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_10"), :"SYS_B_11", NVL(B.PEND_INST, :"SYS_B_12"), NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_13"))) AS TOTODAMT, B.GMST_CODE FROM VIEWLNMAS B WHERE NVL(B.CLOSED, :"SYS_B_14") <> :"SYS_B_15" AND NVL(B.POST, :"SYS_B_16")= :"SYS_B_17" AND B.GMST_CODE=:"SYS_B_18" GROUP BY B.GMST_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_19"+B.AC_NO)>:"SYS_B_20" ) A , BANKMAS B WHERE A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND NVL(A.TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_21")>:"SYS_B_22" )

DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_051")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_052"), :"SYS_B_053"), :"SYS_B_054", ABS(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_055")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_056")), :"SYS_B_057") AS CREDIT, DECODE(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_058", :"SYS_B_059", DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_060")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_061"), :"SYS_B_062"), :"SYS_B_063", :"SYS_B_064", :"SYS_B_065")) AS DRCR, :"SYS_B_066" AS fdcytjj3g2a2xINSERT INTO GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN6 (GMST_CODE, OTHGMST, NRECNO, FORM60_61) SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN7 A, BANKMAS C , GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_00"=:"SYS_B_01" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( ( ( DECODE(NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_02"), :"SYS_B_03", LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))), TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE))), :"SYS_B_04", :"SYS_B_05"))), LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE)), UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))), :"SYS_B_06", :"SYS_B_07"))) ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHGRPID)) ) OR ( UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))) IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))= LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHPANID)) ) ) ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE, NVL(B.LINKGMST, B.GMST_CODE) AS SRCHLINKGMST FROM BANKMAS B, GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN7 A WHERE NVL(B.PANNO(+), :"SYS_B_08") = NVL(A.SRCHPANID, :"SYS_B_09") AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(B.PANNO(+)))) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), :"SYS_B_10") !=:"SYS_B_11" AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), B.GMST_CODE(+)) != A.GMST_CODE ) A, BANKMAS C , GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_12"=:"SYS_B_13" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_14")= NVL(A.SRCHLINKGMST, :"SYS_B_15") AND NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_16")<>:"SYS_B_17" )
fkszph40q7xknINSERT INTO GLBTMPACBK (TDATE, AC_NO, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, DEBIT, CREDIT, BALANCE, DOC_NO, ACMASTCODE, PASS, POST, CTRNNO, OTRNNO, VOU_NO, VOU_SRNO, OP_ID , SU_ID, RC_COUNT, FD_COUNT, CHQ_PREFIX, CASHIER_ID, CASHIER_OK, CASH_CR, CASH_DR, CSHR_EXCP, DENMTION , REF_ACNO, REF_ACMCD , CHQBOUNCE, FORBRANCH, ATBRANCH, VOU_GRNO , DD_GRNO, GOLD_REC_NO, DD_CLEAR, INTFRDT, INTTODT, AC_TYPE, RECEIPTNO, FD_RC_CNT , SHIFT_NO, PROC_SRNO, AC_CODE, TRNSCNID) SELECT A.TDATE, A.AC_NO, A.DRCR, A.CSH_TRN, A.PRTCLS, A.DEBIT, A.CREDIT, A.BALANCE, A.DOC_NO, A.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_00", A.POST, A.CTRNNO, A.OTRNNO, A.VOU_NO, A.VOU_SRNO, A.OP_ID , A.SU_ID, A.RC_COUNT, A.FD_COUNT, A.CHQ_PREFIX, A.CASHIER_ID, A.CASHIER_OK, A.CASH_CR, A.CASH_DR, A.CSHR_EXCP, A.DENMTION , A.REF_ACNO, A.REF_ACMCD , A.CHQBOUNCE, A.FORBRANCH, A.ATBRANCH, A.VOU_GRNO , A.DD_GRNO, A.GOLD_REC_NO, A.DD_CLEAR, A.INTFRDT, A.INTTODT, A.AC_TYPE, A.RECEIPTNO, A.FD_RC_CNT , A.SHIFT_NO, A.PROC_SRNO, B.AC_CODE, A.TRNSCNID FROM ACBK A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.TDATE = :"SYS_B_01" AND ATBRANCH = :"SYS_B_02" AND NVL(A.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_03") !=:"SYS_B_04" AND A.TRN_TYPE = :"SYS_B_05" AND A.CSH_TRN!= :"SYS_B_06" AND NVL(A.SSD_QUICK, :"SYS_B_07")=:"SYS_B_08" AND NVL(A.SRCOFTRN, :"SYS_B_09") NOT IN (:"SYS_B_10", :"SYS_B_11", :"SYS_B_12") AND NVL(A.POST, :"SYS_B_13")<>:"SYS_B_14" ORDER BY VOU_GRNO, OTRNNO

  • % Activity is the percentage of DB Time due to the SQL.
  • % Event is the percentage of DB Time due to the event that the SQL is waiting on.
  • % Row Source is the percentage of DB Time due to the row source for the SQL waiting on the event.
  • Executions is the number of executions of the SQL that were sampled in ASH.

Top Blocking Sessions

  • Blocking session activity percentages are calculated with respect to waits on enqueues, latches and "buffer busy" only
  • '% Activity' represents the load on the database caused by a particular blocking session
  • '# Samples Active' shows the number of ASH samples in which the blocking session was found active.
  • 'XIDs' shows the number of distinct transaction IDs sampled in ASH when the blocking session was found active.
